title: How Hutlihut Games Is Taking Vivox Voice Chat to New Dimensions
summary: See how Hutlihut Games uses Unity Vivox voice chat to make communication part of Void Crew’s co-op gameplay, from immersive events to cross-platform play.
body_markdown:
Rather than simply recreating flat voice channels, Hutlihut wanted voice chat to feel integrated with the action. In *Void Crew* , communication reflects what players are doing, where they are, and what is going wrong in real time—helping sell the tension, fantasy, and chaos of keeping a spaceship together under pressure. In turn, this adds to expressive, dynamic, and memorable gameplay. As the team puts it: “Consider the game a stage on which the players play out their role, and provide them with tools to increase the quality of the drama.”


That is where immersive communication becomes powerful in *Void Crew* . Voice does more than carry instructions; It helps players inhabit their roles, react to each other in real time, and experience the tension of a mission together. The result is communication that supports both gameplay and atmosphere at once.
